comment: The bar the synthetic recall smoke is held to. Recall is 1.0 because the moments were planted: failing to find something put there on purpose is a failure, not a measurement. The duplicate rate was 0.6 on the first honest baseline, recorded rather than chosen — near-duplicate detection ran only before the boundary optimizer decided where clips are cut, so two candidates could converge onto one cut in two clusters and both reach the board. That defect is fixed: select() now refuses a candidate whose CHOSEN interval repeats one already selected, at the same IoU this metric scores duplicates at, and accounts for the refusal as a shortfall rather than filling the set. The ratchet is lowered from 0.6 to 0.0 — not an aspiration but the guarantee the selector now makes, since it and the metric share one threshold and one formula, so any rate above zero means the refusal was weakened. It may be lowered further and must never be raised.
